limits: Read-only HTTP GET inspection only; no restart, deployment, environment update, disk change, signature or transaction requested.

diagnosis.terminalLog: Merkle worker stopped; inspect canonical chain and restart after reconciliation
diagnosis.platformReason: HTTP health check failed with status code 503
diagnosis.exactUnderlyingFailure: UNKNOWN: the deployed worker wrapper discards the error chain and logs only a static category
diagnosis.causeBoundary: One retry warning preceded the first terminal error; the captured sequence does not establish five-retry exhaustion, a cold start, an RPC outage, a canonical mismatch or ambiguous publication as the root cause.
sourceReview: worker.rs retries tagged prepublication ReadUnavailable errors at most five times, then returns an error.
Canonical integrity mismatches and errors classified as PublicationError stop the worker.
Existing-batch contract reads and existing-commitment verification also receive PublicationError classification; a transport error there can stop the worker, but this specific cause is unproven.
The stopped worker makes health return 503; Render recorded failed HTTP health checks and later startup events.
diagnosis.admissionBoundary: The deployed submission_gate checks TASK_SUBMISSION_ENABLED only, independently of batch_health. A failed health check does not prove paid admission is disabled. Public routing is currently unavailable; no POST was sent to test paid admission.
diagnosis.recovery: Keep wallet/live submission unavailable. Preserve the current journal and arrange operator maintenance admission/exclusive signer handoff. Reconcile known transaction nonces, finalized receipts, commitments and facilitator settlement records read-only before any approved restart or migration. Do not clear state or retry ambiguous publication.
